title: Version 1.27.0
html:
Version 1.27.0

July 19th, 2023

Added:

  • Implemented a more performant data system.
  • Added new main menu UI.
  • Added new property selection interface.
  • Added new hotbar with custom item icons.
  • Added new top-bar design.
  • Added new vehicle driving UI.
  • Added new item inspection UI.
  • Added new item interaction UI.
  • Added new interactive tutorial.
  • Added new soft-shutdown system.
  • Added new swing indicator UI.
  • Added new sawing indicator UI.
  • Added new stat tool UI.
  • Added new changelog UI.
  • Added new credits UI.
  • Added new version Indicator.
  • Added new dialog UI (currently only used in the Tutorial).
  • Added new mobile dragging UI.
  • Leaderstats now display for all players!
  • Mobile can ACTUALLY sprint now.

Changed:

  • Players now spawn on their property by default.
  • the old rusty tools and rusty refinery into the basement.
  • Removed stamina.

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issues with dynamite.
  • Fixed minor plank duplication with saws.

Version 1.27.1

July 19th, 2023

Changed:

  • Tutorial no longer needs logs in vehicle due to confusion

Bug Fixes:

  • A bunch of random bugs
  • No more crate bugs!
  • Fixed tools being really bad on mobile

Version 1.27.2

July 20th, 2023

Changed:

  • Trees and planks are now 8 sided (7 sided prior)
  • Trees and planks now use box collision!
  • Mobile Dragging has been HEAVILY improved
  • Removed bumpy meshes from rocks in preparation for map revamp

Version 1.27.3

July 20th, 2023

Changed:

  • Changed color of Play Solo due to players getting confused

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed dragging & hover issues on Controller
  • Fixed issue with some UI disappearing on death

Version 1.27.4

July 20th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed crates not anchoring
  • Fixed interactions not working on mobile
  • Fixed mobile UI never appearing after load
  • Fixed issue with maps not displaying the correct property location
